generation.scope: Every ordinary negative fixed curve has no first obstruction in length five. The same is proved on every positive fixed curve over a common Zariski open of slopes containing (3,2), by eight characteristic and starting-position minors and a finite specialization argument.

proof_review.scope: Reviewed odd-length character exchange, primitive row contents and determinant multipliers, proper finite projection and the separated companion sections.

mathematical_computation.scope: Certified eight exact four-variable degree-five minors, checked all projected factors on the negative curve and degree-preserving unramified finite first-coordinate factors above the (3,2) positive slice.

tex.engine: LuaHBTeX; no overfull boxes, missing glyphs or undefined references

open_mathematics: Decide the remaining special slopes of the positive fixed curve in length five. The additional projected factors from its 86-by-86 minors are explicit in the integer polynomial computation. Compare independent minors on their common roots and on the four residual positive sections. In parallel as a mathematical alternative, test whether length six introduces genuinely new obstructions.
